players.product: Ovation control systems for power plants (fleet modernizations, new gas-fired capacity and behind-the-meter generation for data centers)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K segment review, fiscal 2025 vs 2024: Software and Control sales were $5.7 billion, up 5 percent; Control Systems & Software sales ($4,205 million vs $3,935 million) increased $270, or 7 percent, reflecting strong growth at AspenTech (including a favorable impact related to the timing of contract renewals) and favorable demand in process and power end markets across all geographies; Software and Control adjusted EBITA margin was 31.0 percent. Intelligent Devices sales were $12.4 billion, up 2 percent; Final Control sales increased $176, or 4 percent, reflecting strength in power end markets.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 Control Systems & Software sales $4,205 million (+7%); Software and Control $5.7 billion (+5%); Final Control +4% on power end markets
